en: A black‑and‑white view of a vaulted Gothic arcade with pointed arches supported by sturdy stone columns. One side is lined with rough masonry wall, the other opens to a courtyard or street where a cart wheel is faintly visible. The perspective looks along the length of the covered walkway toward an opening with light and distant buildings. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century architectural photograph possibly reproduced as a postcard. Some faint, handwritten numbers or marks appear along the lower left edge.
